from datetime import datetime

venmo_password = next(item['password'] for item in passwords if item['account_name'] == 'venmo')
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='mel.bailey@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)
venmo_access_token = venmo_login['access_token']

social_feed = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_social_feed(
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    social_feed.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

today = datetime.strptime(current_datetime['date'], '%A, %B %d, %Y').date()
roommate_emails = {contact['email'].lower() for contact in roommates}
target_transactions = [
    transaction for transaction in social_feed
    if datetime.fromisoformat(transaction['created_at']).date() == today
    and (
        transaction['sender']['email'].lower() in roommate_emails
        or transaction['receiver']['email'].lower() in roommate_emails
    )
]
print(target_transactions)
